tax_name: skatt på flygresor (flygskatt) (Tax on air travel (aviation tax))
legal_basis: Lag (2017:1200) om skatt på flygresor, utfärdad 2017-11-30 (SFS 2017:1200; prop. 2017/18:1, bet. 2017/18:FiU1, rskr. 2017/18:54)
rate_structure: Per departing passenger, by final destination in travel documents: SEK 60 (Annex 1 countries, Europe), SEK 250 (Annex 2 countries, mainly up to about 6,000 km from Arlanda incl. USA, Canada, Middle East, North Africa), SEK 400 (all other). Before: no tax. Amounts CPI-indexed annually from 2019 (8 §).
transfer_exempt: yes: transit passengers continuing on the same aircraft, and transfer passengers continuing on another aircraft if the onward flight per the travel documentation begins within 24 hours (4 § points 4-5)
applies_to: Passengers departing from airports in Sweden on commercial flights with aircraft approved for more than 10 passengers; domestic and international departures; arrivals not taxed
notes: Effective date basis: By departure: liability arises when the aircraft takes off from a Swedish airport (6 §); the law entered into force 2018-04-01. No transitional rule exempting tickets sold before a date was found in the published SFS text. Also exempt: children under 2, crew on duty, re-departures after disruption. Announcement date = Lagrådsremiss 'Skatt på flygresor' (8 June 2017); the inquiry SOU 2016:83 had proposed 1 Jan 2018. Lead's 'tickets bought before a certain date' rule not found: the law has no such rule.
source_quote: Skatten ska betalas med ... 60 kronor per passagerare som reser till en slutdestination i ett land som anges i bilaga 1 till denna lag ... Denna lag träder i kraft den 1 april 2018. [Tax is SEK 60 per passenger to an Annex 1 destination ... This law enters into force on 1 April 2018.] | Stockholm den 8 juni 2017 [date of the referral to the Council on Legislation]

tax_name: skatt på flygresor (flygskatt) (Tax on air travel (aviation tax))
legal_basis: Lag (2017:1200) 8 § annual indexation; Förordning (2022:1594) (2023 amounts); Förordning (2023:587) om fastställande av omräknade belopp för flygskatt för år 2024
rate_structure: 2024: SEK 76 / 315 / 504 per passenger (Annex 1 / Annex 2 / other). Before (2023): SEK 69 / 288 / 461. 2025: SEK 77 / 323 / 517.
transfer_exempt: yes: same 24-hour transfer and transit exemption as at introduction
applies_to: Departing passengers from Swedish airports
notes: Effective date basis: By departure (takeoff on or after 1 Jan 2024). below 20% threshold (+10%). Annual CPI indexation; cumulative 2018-2024 rise about 27% (60 to 76). Announcement date = Skatteverket notice date.
source_quote: 76 kronor per passagerare som reser till en slutdestination i ett land ... 315 kronor ... 504 kronor per passagerare som reser till en annan slutdestination [2024 amounts] | 69 kronor ... 288 kronor ... 461 kronor per passagerare [2023 amounts]

tax_name: skatt på flygresor (flygskatt) (Tax on air travel (aviation tax))
legal_basis: Lag (2024:1138) om upphävande av lagen (2017:1200) om skatt på flygresor, utfärdad 2024-11-28 (prop. 2024/25:1, bet. 2024/25:FiU1, rskr. 2024/25:49)
rate_structure: After: none. Before (2025 amounts): SEK 77 / 323 / 517 per departing passenger (Annex 1 / Annex 2 / other).
transfer_exempt: not applicable (abolition); before abolition yes: transfer within 24 hours exempt
applies_to: Departing passengers from Swedish airports
notes: Effective date basis: Law repealed from 1 July 2025; the repealed law still applies to circumstances before that date, i.e. liability by takeoff date (flights taking off before 1 July 2025 remain taxable). effective outside window. Announced in government press release of 3 Sep 2024 (budget bill for 2025). Earlier, Promemoria 'Sänkt flygskatt' (22 Apr 2024) had proposed halving to SEK 39/162/259 from 1 Jan 2025; superseded and not enacted.
source_quote: 1. Denna lag träder i kraft den 1 juli 2025. 2. Den upphävda lagen gäller dock fortfarande i fråga om förhållanden som hänför sig till tiden före ikraftträdandet. [In force 1 July 2025; repealed law still applies to circumstances before then.] | Den avskaffade flygskatten föreslås träda i kraft från och med 1 juli. [The abolition is proposed to take effect from 1 July.]

tax_name: avgift på flyging av passasjerer, omgjort til flyseteavgift (Air passenger tax converted to aircraft seat tax)
legal_basis: Stortingets vedtak om særavgifter for 1998 (Budsjett-innst. S. nr. 1 (1997-98), 21.11.1997; St.prp. nr. 1 Tillegg nr. 1 (1997-98)); lov 19. mai 1933 nr. 11 om særavgifter
rate_structure: After: NOK 130 per seat on flights from Norway abroad; NOK 65 per seat on Oslo to Bergen/Kristiansand/Stavanger/Trondheim routes (all seats, sold or not). Before: NOK 141 per passenger abroad, NOK 70.50 per passenger domestic (1997 rates, also Jan-Mar 1998).
transfer_exempt: no: under the seat basis the transit/transfer exemption was removed, each taxable sector charged; before 1 April 1998 transit/transfer passengers were exempt if the trip was in direct connection with another flight
applies_to: Commercial flights departing Norway to abroad, and domestic flights between Oslo and Bergen, Kristiansand, Stavanger, Trondheim
notes: Effective date basis: By flight date (vedtak A applies 1 Jan to 31 Mar 1998; vedtak B 'Flyseteavgift' from 1 April 1998). Tax originated 1 Jan 1994 (NOK 60 per trip abroad, replacing charter tax); from 1 Apr 1995 NOK 130 abroad / 65 domestic; small price adjustments to 141 / 70.50 by 1997. Per-seat basis lasted 1 Apr 1998 to 31 May 1999 (confirmed by Høyesterett HR-2008-00935-A). Announcement: Bondevik government's St.prp. nr. 1 Tillegg nr. 1 (autumn 1997), exact date not opened; Budsjett-innst. dated 21 Nov 1997.
source_quote: B. Flyseteavgift § 1. Fra 1. april 1998 ... For flyging fra norsk lufthavn til utlandet betales avgift med kr 130 pr. sete [Seat tax from 1 April 1998: NOK 130 per seat abroad] ... foreslås også dette fritaket opphevet [the transit/transfer exemption is also proposed abolished] | bortsett fra en periode i 1998-99, da den var knyttet til antallet flyseter [except a period in 1998-99 when it was tied to the number of seats]

tax_name: flyseteavgift (from 30 Nov 1998 titled 'avgift på flyging') (Aircraft seat tax)
legal_basis: Stortingets vedtak 17. juni 1998 om flyseteavgift for 1999 (Innst. S. nr. 247 (1997-98), grønn skatteomlegging); amended by vedtak 30. november 1998 (Budsjett-innst. S. nr. 1 (1998-99))
rate_structure: After: NOK 106 per seat abroad, NOK 53 per seat domestic (Oslo to 4 cities); price adjusted to 109 / 54.50 from 1 April 1999. Before: NOK 130 / 65 per seat.
transfer_exempt: no: seat basis, no transit/transfer exemption
applies_to: Flights from Norway abroad and Oslo to Bergen/Kristiansand/Stavanger/Trondheim; flights from Finnmark and 7 Nord-Troms municipalities exempt (exemption introduced with revised budget 1998)
notes: Effective date basis: By flight date. below 20% threshold (-18.5%). Reduction coincided with the introduction of a CO2 tax on aviation fuel from 1 Jan 1999 (green tax shift). The 30 Nov 1998 vedtak text for the 1 April 1999 adjustment reads 'pr. passasjer', but Innst. S. nr. 163 (1998-99) still refers to the seat tax in May 1999.
source_quote: V. Flyseteavgift § 1. Fra 1. januar 1999 ... a) For flyging fra norsk lufthavn til utlandet betales avgift med kr 106 pr. sete. b) ... kr 53 pr. sete. | T.o.m. 31.3.99 F.o.m. 1.4.99 Innenlands 53,00 54,50 Til utlandet 106,00 109,00

tax_name: avgift på flyging av passasjerer (Air passenger tax (return from seat basis to passenger basis))
legal_basis: Stortingets vedtak om avgift på flyging av passasjerer fra 1. juni 1999 (Innst. S. nr. 163 (1998-99), 4 May 1999); lov 19. mai 1933 nr. 11; forskrift 23 des 1993 nr. 1338 § 4 (added by forskrift 28 mai 1999 nr. 661)
rate_structure: After: NOK 228 per passenger abroad, NOK 114 per passenger Oslo to Bergen/Kristiansand/Stavanger/Trondheim. Before: per seat NOK 109 abroad / 54.50 domestic (from 1 Apr 1999). Price adjusted to 232 / 116 from 1 April 2000 (below 20% threshold).
transfer_exempt: yes: transit and transfer passengers exempt 'såfremt reisen står i direkte forbindelse med annen flyreise' (if the trip is in direct connection with another flight)
applies_to: Departing passengers on commercial flights from Norway to abroad and on the four Oslo domestic routes; flights from Finnmark and 7 Nord-Troms municipalities exempt
notes: Effective date basis: By flight date (vedtak in force 1 June 1999; seat tax vedtak of 17 June and 30 Nov 1998 repealed from that date). Committee majority (Ap, FrP, H, TF) found the seat tax mainly fiscal and harmful to new entrants. ESA letter of formal notice 16 Dec 1998 objected to different domestic and international rates (not resolved by this change). Per-passenger rate roughly doubled versus per-seat rate.
source_quote: Fra 1. juni 1999 skal det ... betales avgift ... 1. For flyging fra norsk lufthavn til utlandet betales avgift med kr 228 pr. passasjer. 2. For flyging i Norge mellom steder nevnt i § 1 betales avgift med kr 114 pr. passasjer. | Transitt- og transferpassasjerer, såfremt reisen står i direkte forbindelse med annen flyreise.

tax_name: avgift på flyging av passasjerer (Air passenger tax (equalised single rate, extended domestic scope))
legal_basis: Stortingets vedtak om avgift på flyging av passasjerer for 2001 (St.prp. nr. 1 (2000-2001) Skatte-, avgifts- og tollvedtak; Budsjett-innst. S. nr. 1 (2000-2001)); lov 19. mai 1933 nr. 11
rate_structure: After: NOK 128 per passenger for all taxable domestic and international flights. Before: NOK 232 per passenger abroad (one way), NOK 116 domestic (Oslo to 4 cities only). International rate cut about 45%; domestic rate +10% and base widened.
transfer_exempt: yes: transit and transfer passengers exempt if the trip is in direct connection with another flight
applies_to: Departing passengers on commercial flights from Norwegian airports; domestic scope extended to all flights in South Norway and to/from Tromsø and Bodø; other airports in Nordland, Troms, Finnmark exempt; flights to Svalbard exempt (clarified from 1 July 2001, Innst. S. nr. 325 (2000-2001))
notes: Effective date basis: By flight date. Change made after ESA reasoned opinion that different domestic and international rates breached EEA Art. 36. Introduced together with zero-rate VAT on air passenger transport (from 1 July 2001). Proposal in St.prp. nr. 1 (2000-2001), October 2000 (exact date not opened).
source_quote: Avgiftssatsen for flypassasjeravgiften vil fra 1. april 2001 være 128 kroner, og gjelder både avgiftspliktige flyginger innenlands og til utlandet. [From 1 April 2001 the rate is NOK 128 for both domestic and international taxable flights.] | besluttet Stortinget at avgiften med virkning fra 1. april 2001 skulle være lik for alle flyvinger i og fra Norge

tax_name: avgift på flyging av passasjerer (Air passenger tax)
legal_basis: Stortingets vedtak om avgift på flyging av passasjerer for 2002 (St.prp. nr. 1 Tillegg nr. 4 (2001-2002), Bondevik II; Budsjett-innst. S. nr. 1 (2001-2002), 20.11.2001)
rate_structure: After: none. Before: NOK 128 per passenger (1 Jan to 31 Mar 2002).
transfer_exempt: not applicable (abolition); before: yes, transit/transfer exempt if in direct connection with another flight
applies_to: All taxable commercial flights from Norwegian airports
notes: Effective date basis: By flight date: vedtak levies the tax only from 1 Jan 2002 to 31 Mar 2002. Abolition proposed by the Bondevik II government to improve profitability and lower entry barriers in Norwegian aviation; Stoltenberg proposal (NOK 130 from 1 Apr 2002) rejected. Announcement date = committee recommendation date (Tillegg nr. 4 date not opened). Annual revenue loss about NOK 1,655 million.
source_quote: Regjeringen foreslår at avgiften på flyging av passasjerer avvikles fra 1. april 2002. ... Fra 1. januar 2002 t.o.m. 31. mars 2002 skal det ... betales avgift ... med kr 128 pr. passasjer. | passasjeravgiften er avviklet fra 1. april 2002

tax_name: flypassasjeravgift (Air passenger tax)
legal_basis: Stortingets vedtak om særavgifter for 2016, nytt kapittel Flypassasjeravgift (Innst. 3 S (2015-2016), vedtak 14.12.2015); lov 19. mai 1933 nr. 11 om særavgifter; forskrift om særavgifter §§ 3-22-1 to 3-22-5 (forskrift 13. mai 2016 nr. 496)
rate_structure: NOK 80 per passenger, single rate, all departures from Norwegian airports. Before: none. Price adjusted to NOK 82 (2017), 83 (2018), 84 (Jan-Mar 2019).
transfer_exempt: yes: first flight of a transit/transfer journey taxable if departure airport is Norwegian, all subsequent flights exempt; onward flight must begin within 24 hours and be in direct connection (saf. § 3-22-5, in force 1 June 2016)
applies_to: Passengers departing Norwegian airports on commercial flights (domestic and international); flights from continental shelf and Svalbard not taxable; arrivals not taxed
notes: Effective date basis: By flight date: applies to all flights taking place on or after 1 June 2016; liability arises when the flight begins (takeoff). Budget agreement H, FrP, KrF, V (autumn 2015). Vedtak foresaw 1 April 2016; start postponed to 1 June 2016 after state-aid questions raised with ESA (secondary lead, not opened in a primary source). Children under 2 and airline staff on duty exempt.
source_quote: betales avgift til statskassen på ervervsmessig flyging fra norske lufthavner med kr 80 per passasjer | Stortinget vedtok 14. desember 2015 å innføre avgift ... Avgiften trådte i kraft 1. juni 2016, for alle flyginger som skjer fra og med denne datoen. ... Den påfølgende flygingen må påbegynnes innen 24 timer etter den foregående

tax_name: flypassasjeravgift (Air passenger tax (distance differentiation))
legal_basis: Stortingets vedtak om flypassasjeravgift for 2019, romertall II ('fra den tid departementet bestemmer'); Innst. 3 S (2018-2019), 5 Dec 2018; Prop. 1 LS (2018-2019); saf. § 3-22-1
rate_structure: After: NOK 75 per passenger for final destination in Europe (list in saf. § 3-22-1, roughly capitals within 2,500 km of Oslo), NOK 200 per passenger for other final destinations. Before: single rate NOK 84 (2019).
transfer_exempt: yes: unchanged 24-hour transfer exemption; first leg taxed at the rate of the final destination
applies_to: Passengers departing Norwegian airports, domestic and international
notes: Effective date basis: By flight date (rate determined by final destination in ticket or travel document). Revenue-neutral restructuring; long-haul rate +138%, Europe/domestic -11%. Opposition warned it could weaken Gardermoen as an intercontinental gateway and shift traffic to Copenhagen. Announcement date = committee recommendation date (Prop. 1 LS of Oct 2018 not opened).
source_quote: Flypassasjeravgiften ble lagt om 1. april 2019. Tidligere var det én sats (84 kroner for 2019) for alle flyvninger. [The tax was restructured on 1 April 2019; previously one rate, NOK 84 for 2019.] | Det foreslås at omleggingen gjøres provenynøytral slik at satsene settes til 75 og 200 kroner.

tax_name: flypassasjeravgift (Air passenger tax)
legal_basis: Stortingets vedtak March 2020 (Prop. 52 S / Prop. 53 LS (2019-2020); Innst. 197 S (2019-2020)); extended by Storting vedtak of 9 Oct 2020 (rest of 2020), by budget for 2021 (Innst. 3 S (2020-2021), 8 Dec 2020), and to 30 June 2022 (vedtak 24 Jan 2022)
rate_structure: After: zero. Before (nominal 2020 rates): NOK 76.50 Europe / NOK 204 other per passenger.
transfer_exempt: not applicable (suspended)
applies_to: All departing passengers from Norwegian airports
notes: Effective date basis: Retroactive, by flight date: no tax for flights taking place from 1 Jan 2020; suspension ultimately covered 1 Jan 2020 to 30 June 2022. COVID-19 relief. Initially 1 Jan to 31 Oct 2020; extended to end-2020 (Innst. 3 S (2020-2021) cites 'vedtak av 9. oktober 2021', evidently a typo for 2020), then through 2021, then to 30 June 2022. Announcement date = date Innst. 197 S became available (23 Mar 2020).
source_quote: Midlertidig oppheving av flypassasjeravgiften for flygninger som finner sted i perioden fra 1. januar 2020 til og med 31. oktober 2020. | var på grunn av pandemien avviklet i perioden 1. januar 2020 til 30. juni 2022 [was abolished because of the pandemic from 1 Jan 2020 to 30 June 2022]

tax_name: flypassasjeravgift (Air passenger tax)
legal_basis: Stortingets vedtak om flypassasjeravgift for 2022 (budget 2022), as amended by Storting vedtak 24 Jan 2022 postponing reinstatement to 1 July 2022
rate_structure: After: NOK 80 per passenger (final destination in Europe), NOK 214 (other). Before: zero (suspended).
transfer_exempt: yes: 24-hour transfer/transit exemption (saf. § 3-22-5) unchanged
applies_to: Passengers departing Norwegian airports, domestic and international
notes: Effective date basis: By flight date (flights from 1 July 2022). Reinstatement originally set for 1 Jan 2022, postponed on 24 Jan 2022.
source_quote: Stortinget vedtok 24. januar 2022 å utsette gjeninnføringen av flypassasjeravgiften til 1. juli 2022. | Lav sats Reiser med sluttdestinasjon i Europa 80,00 kroner per passasjer Høy sats Andre sluttdestinasjoner 214 kroner per passasjer

tax_name: flypassasjeravgift (Air passenger tax)
legal_basis: Stortingets vedtak om flypassasjeravgift for 2023 (Innst. 3 S (2022-2023), 6 Dec 2022; budget agreement Ap, Sp, SV)
rate_structure: After: NOK 82 (Europe) / NOK 320 (other) per passenger. Before: NOK 80 / 214.
transfer_exempt: yes: 24-hour transfer/transit exemption unchanged
applies_to: Passengers departing Norwegian airports
notes: Effective date basis: By flight date. High (non-Europe) rate +50% (NOK 100 above the government proposal of price adjustment only); Europe rate +2.5%. Announcement date = committee recommendation date.
source_quote: foreslår som følge av budsjettforliket å øke flypassasjeravgiften for reiser ut av Europa med 100 kroner ... § 1 Fra 1. januar 2023 ... a. flyginger med sluttdestinasjon i Europa: kr 82 b. andre flyginger: kr 320.

tax_name: flypassasjeravgift (Air passenger tax)
legal_basis: Stortingets vedtak om flypassasjeravgift for 2024
rate_structure: After: NOK 85 (Europe) / NOK 332 (other). Before: NOK 82 / 320.
transfer_exempt: yes: 24-hour transfer/transit exemption unchanged
applies_to: Passengers departing Norwegian airports
notes: Effective date basis: By flight date. below 20% threshold (price adjustment, about +4%).
source_quote: Lav sats Reiser med sluttdestinasjon i Europa 85 kroner per passasjer Høy sats Andre sluttdestinasjoner 332 kroner per passasjer

tax_name: flypassasjeravgift (Air passenger tax)
legal_basis: Stortingets vedtak om flypassasjeravgift for 2025 (Prop. 1 LS (2024-2025); Innst. 3 S (2024-2025), 9 Dec 2024)
rate_structure: After: NOK 60 (Europe) / NOK 342 (other) per passenger. Before: NOK 85 / 332.
transfer_exempt: yes: 24-hour transfer/transit exemption unchanged
applies_to: Passengers departing Norwegian airports
notes: Effective date basis: By flight date. effective outside window. Europe/domestic rate cut about 29% (government proposal 'om å redusere flypassasjeravgiften'); long-haul rate +3%. Proposal published with the 2025 budget in October 2024 (Prop. 1 LS not opened, regjeringen.no blocked). 2026 rates NOK 61 / 350.
source_quote: Lav sats Reiser med sluttdestinasjon i Europa 60 kroner per passasjer Høy sats Andre sluttdestinasjoner 342 kroner per passasjer | Dette medlem viser til regjeringas forslag om å redusere flypassasjeravgiften [refers to the government's proposal to reduce the air passenger tax]

tax_name: passagerafgift (lov om afgift af visse flyrejser) (Passenger tax (Act on duty on certain air journeys))
legal_basis: Lov nr. 449 af 10/06/1997 om ændring af lov om afgift af visse flyrejser (Passagerafgift på indenrigsfly); lovforslag 1996/1 LSF 253 fremsat 6 May 1997; base act lov nr. 389 af 06/06/1991
rate_structure: After: DKK 75 per departing passenger, domestic and international. Before: DKK 65 per passenger departing to abroad only; domestic flights untaxed.
transfer_exempt: yes: transit and transfer passengers exempt 'såfremt rejsen står i direkte forbindelse med anden flyrejse' (if in direct connection with another flight); before 1998 the wording referred to connection with a flight from abroad
applies_to: Passengers departing Danish airports in aircraft with more than 10 seats or MTOW above 5,700 kg; domestic added from 1998; not Faroe Islands or Greenland
notes: Effective date basis: By departure (afgift per afrejsende passager from 1 Jan 1998). Prompted by European Commission letter SG(96) D/11605 (23 Dec 1996) finding the international-only tax contrary to free provision of services. International rate +15% (unchanged since 1 Sep 1991). Bill remarks state Danish hub transit role unaffected because of transfer exemption.
source_quote: I § 1 udgår »til udlandet«. ... »Afgiften udgør 75 kr. pr. passager, der fra dansk lufthavn rejser som passager i et luftfartøj ...« ... Loven træder i kraft den 1. januar 1998. | forhøjes afgiften med 10 kr. og udgør derefter 75 kr. pr. afrejsende passager [the tax is raised by DKK 10 to DKK 75 per departing passenger]

tax_name: passagerafgift (lov om afgift af visse flyrejser) (Passenger tax)
legal_basis: Lov nr. 834 af 27/11/1998 om ændring af lov om afgift af visse flyrejser (Halvering af afgiften for mindre fly på visse ruter); lovforslag 1998/1 L 34 fremsat 8 Oct 1998
rate_structure: After: DKK 37.50 per passenger for aircraft with fewer than 20 seats or MTOW under 10,000 kg, only on routes not served by larger aircraft; DKK 75 otherwise. Before: DKK 75 for all.
transfer_exempt: yes: transit/transfer exempt if in direct connection with another flight
applies_to: Departing passengers on small aircraft on thin routes (mainly domestic/regional)
notes: Effective date basis: By departure. Narrow scope change; half rate for small aircraft on routes without larger aircraft.
source_quote: For passagerer, der fra dansk lufthavn rejser som passager i et luftfartøj, der er godkendt til færre end 20 passagersæder, eller som har største tilladte startvægt på under 10.000 kg, udgør afgiften 37,5 kr. pr. passager. ... Loven træder i kraft den 1. december 1998.

tax_name: passagerafgift (lov om afgift af visse flyrejser) (Passenger tax)
legal_basis: Lov nr. 1415 af 21/12/2005 om ændring og senere ophævelse af lov om afgift af visse flyrejser (Aftrapning af passagerafgift), § 1; lovforslag 2005/1 L 80 fremsat 16 Nov 2005 (finanslovaftale 2006, V, K, DF)
rate_structure: After: DKK 37.50 per departing passenger (standard), DKK 18.75 (small aircraft on thin routes). Before: DKK 75 / 37.50.
transfer_exempt: yes: transit/transfer exempt if in direct connection with another flight
applies_to: Passengers departing Danish airports, domestic and international
notes: Effective date basis: By departure: halving applies to departures from and including 1 Jan 2006. First step of two-year phase-out agreed in the 2006 Finance Act agreement to support Danish airports, regional airports and low-cost routes.
source_quote: I § 2, stk. 1, ændres »75 kr.« til: »37,50 kr.« ... Lovens § 1 træder i kraft den 1. januar 2006. | halvering af afgiften ved afrejse fra og med den 1. januar 2006 og afskaffelse af afgiften pr. 1. januar 2007

tax_name: passagerafgift (lov om afgift af visse flyrejser) (Passenger tax)
legal_basis: Lov nr. 1415 af 21/12/2005, § 2 (repeal of lov om afgift af visse flyrejser, jf. LBK nr. 566 af 03/08/1998)
rate_structure: After: none. Before: DKK 37.50 per departing passenger (DKK 18.75 small aircraft).
transfer_exempt: not applicable (abolition)
applies_to: Passengers departing Danish airports
notes: Effective date basis: By departure (repeal in force 1 Jan 2007). No Danish national passenger tax from 2007 until 2025 (CE Delft 2019 for the European Commission lists 'Denmark No aviation tax').
source_quote: § 2 Lov om afgift af visse flyrejser, jf. lovbekendtgørelse nr. 566 af 3. august 1998, ophæves. ... Lovens § 2 træder i kraft den 1. januar 2007. | trådte i kraft den 1. september 1991 og ophævet den 1. januar 2007

tax_name: passagerafgift på flyrejser (Passenger tax on air travel)
legal_basis: Lov nr. 620 af 11/06/2024 om passagerafgift på flyrejser; lovforslag 2023/1 L 184 (fremsat 30 Apr 2024); Aftale om Grøn luftfart i Danmark af 15. december 2023
rate_structure: Per departing passenger by final destination: Annex 1 (Europe) DKK 30 (2025-2027), 40 (2028-2029), 50 (from 2030); Annex 2 (medium, same country list logic as Swedish law) DKK 250 (2025), 260, 270, 280, 300, 310 (2030); other DKK 300 (2025), 320, 340, 350, 390, 410 (2030). CPI indexation from 2031. Before: none.
transfer_exempt: yes: transit and transfer passengers exempt if the trip is in direct connection with another flight within 24 hours with departure from Denmark (§ 2 stk. 2 nr. 1)
applies_to: Passengers departing Denmark on commercial flights (aircraft with more than 10 seats or MTOW above 5,700 kg), including domestic and flights to Faroe Islands and Greenland; not departures from Faroe Islands or Greenland
notes: Effective date basis: By both: applies to commercial flights departing from 1 Jan 2025 for which the ticket was sold on or after 1 Jan 2025 (tickets sold earlier exempt); liability arises at departure. effective outside window. Lead partly wrong: only the Europe band starts low and rises (30 to 50); medium and long-haul bands start at DKK 250 and 300. Revenue earmarked to green transition of domestic aviation.
source_quote: Loven finder alene anvendelse på passagerers kommercielle flyrejser fra og med den 1. januar 2025, hvor en flybillet ... er solgt den 1. januar 2025 eller senere. ... transit- og transferpassagerer, hvis rejsen står i direkte forbindelse med en anden flyrejse inden for 24 timer med afgang fra Danmark | med Aftale om Grøn luftfart i Danmark af den 15. december 2023

tax_name: No national air passenger tax
notes: No national per-passenger aviation tax found for 1996-2024. Supporting source is secondary and point-in-time (2019). Finland applies reduced VAT (10%) on domestic air transport only; airport charges are set by Finavia (out of scope). Finnish government portals (vm.fi, valtioneuvosto.fi) returned HTTP 403, so no Finnish primary source could be opened; 2019-2020 policy discussions of a flight tax not verified.
source_quote: Finland does not impose a ticket tax on air passengers. The country levies a VAT of 10% on domestic flights, but no excise duty on kerosene.

tax_name: flugvallagjald, replaced by flugvallaskattur (Airport fee per passenger, restructured as airport tax)
legal_basis: Lög nr. 95/2004 um breytingu á lögum um flugmálaáætlun og fjáröflun til flugmála, nr. 31/1987 (samþykkt á Alþingi 28 May 2004)
rate_structure: After: flugvallaskattur ISK 382 per passenger on domestic scheduled/commercial flights and on flights from Iceland abroad (half for ages 2-12). Before: flugvallagjald ISK 750 per passenger travelling from Iceland abroad and ISK 100 per passenger domestic or to Faroe Islands/Greenland (unchanged in law editions Oct 1995 to July 2003). Combined with the new varaflugvallagjald (separate row) the international departure charge rose from ISK 750 to 980 (+31%); domestic from ISK 100 to 382.

tax_name: Taxa de carbono sobre viagens aéreas (taxa de carbono sobre os bilhetes do transporte aéreo comercial de passageiros) (Carbon tax on air travel (on commercial air passenger tickets))
legal_basis: Lei n.º 75-B/2020, de 31 de dezembro (Orçamento do Estado 2021), art. 390.º; Portaria n.º 38/2021, de 16 de fevereiro (DR 1.ª série), arts. 9.º-18.º and 21.º
rate_structure: EUR 2 flat per passenger (Art. 13.º), on tickets for commercial flights departing airports/aerodromes in Portuguese territory. Before: none.
transfer_exempt: no: Art. 14.º exemptions are only children under 2, flights to the Azores/Madeira, flights from the Azores/Madeira to national territory, forced technical/weather landings, and PSO services; no transit or transfer exemption. For a single-transaction multi-leg itinerary the tax is collected by the carrier operating the departure from Portugal (Art. 12.º n.º 2); whether a connecting passenger at LIS pays once per ticket is not stated.
applies_to: Departing passengers on commercial flights from all Portuguese airports (domestic and international); arrivals not taxed; Azores/Madeira routes exempt.
notes: Effective date basis: By ticket transaction date: the taxable event is the legal transaction granting a commercial air ticket for a departure from a Portuguese airport (Art. 11.º), liquidated and collected by the airline at ticket issuance (Art. 16.º n.º 1); Art. 21.º: due for taxable events occurring on or after 1 July 2021. Airlines remit to ANAC by the 20th of the month after the passenger's embarkation. Treatment of tickets sold before 1 July 2021 for later flights is not stated explicitly. Lead confirmed (Portaria 38/2021, EUR 2, from 2021-07-01). Portaria published 2021-02-16; announcement_date is the publication of the enabling budget law. Revenue goes to the Fundo Ambiental via ANAC (Art. 18.º); ANAC keeps 3%. Lei n.º 82/2023 (OE 2024) later moved the rule into Lei 82-D/2014 as art. 49.º-Q (same EUR 2; adds exemption for duly proven humanitarian flights); not a material change. A separate maritime carbon tax (EUR 2 per cruise passenger) was created by the same Portaria (not aviation). Portugal's taxa de segurança was checked and not recorded: its state component (INAC/ANAC and security forces; 0.87 Schengen, 2.36 intra-EU non-Schengen, 5.09 international EUR per embarked passenger at ANA airports) is unchanged since Portaria 77-B/2014 (Portaria 235/2014 states no increase in the overall fee); the component raised to EUR 2.95 (2022-02-10, Portaria 92/2022) and EUR 3.54 (2022-09-13, Portaria 235/2022) is revenue of the airport operator ANA, so it was treated as an airport charge. DRE pages were read in a browser (JS-rendered), ANAC consolidated PDF read as text.

tax_name: Taxa de carbono sobre o consumidor de viagens aéreas em aeronaves com capacidade máxima de até 19 lugares (Carbon tax on air travel in aircraft with up to 19 seats (business/private aviation))
legal_basis: Lei n.º 24-D/2022, de 30 de dezembro (OE 2023), art. 184.º; Portaria n.º 110/2023, de 21 de abril (amending Portaria 38/2021, arts. 9.º-16.º and 18.º); Portaria n.º 242/2023, de 28 de julho (definitions)
rate_structure: Per flight (not per ticket) for fossil-fuel aircraft with max 19 passenger seats departing Portugal, commercial or non-commercial: value = TC x CP x L x (D+1), with TC = EUR 2, CP = 10, L = max seats (factory configuration), D = thousands of km to final destination (rounded to one decimal). Example: 8-seat jet, 1,500 km: 2 x 10 x 8 x 2.5 = EUR 400. Before: such flights outside the EUR 2 ticket tax (non-commercial flights not covered). The EUR 2 per passenger tax for larger aircraft is unchanged (Art. 13.º n.º 1, now 'por cada passageiro embarcado').
transfer_exempt: not applicable (levied per flight on small aircraft); exemptions: fully electric aircraft, PSO, state, training, medical emergency, search and rescue flights, take-offs after technical/weather diversions (Art. 14.º n.º 2).
applies_to: Departures from Portuguese airports/aerodromes by aircraft with up to 19 seats, commercial and non-commercial, domestic and international.
notes: Effective date basis: By flight date: Portaria 110/2023 Art. 3.º, due for all commercial or non-commercial flights performed on or after 1 July 2023; liquidated after the flight (Art. 16.º n.º 2). Marginal for hub/airline network analysis (business and private aviation only). Announcement: enabling budget law published 2022-12-30; Portaria 110/2023 published 2023-04-21. Lei 82/2023 later codified it as art. 49.º-R of Lei 82-D/2014 and provided a proportional reduction for aircraft using low-carbon fuels (not quantified here).

tax_name: Τέλος Εκσυγχρονισμού και Ανάπτυξης Αερολιμένων (Τ.Ε.Α.Α., 'Σπατόσημο') (Airport Modernisation and Development Fee (TEAA, 'Spatosimo'))
rate_structure: After: EUR 12 per departing passenger over 5 years with final destination in an EU/EEA airport (domestic flights included as EU), EUR 22 with final destination outside the EU/EEA. Before (Ν. 2065/1992 art. 40 par. 7): drachma equivalent of 10 ECU for final destinations 100-750 km from the departure airport and 20 ECU for more than 750 km, passengers over 12 years (flights under 100 km not taxed). Changes: long-haul intra-EU 20 ECU to EUR 12 (-40%), domestic/short trips 10 ECU to EUR 12 (+20%), non-EU over 750 km 20 ECU to EUR 22 (+10%); switch from distance bands to EU/non-EU bands; children 5-12 newly taxed.
transfer_exempt: not confirmed: the 2001 text exempts only PSO routes (par. 7 γ) and lets joint ministerial decisions set 'ειδικές εξαιρέσεις' (special exemptions, par. 13); no transfer exemption appears in the law text read.
applies_to: All departing passengers from Greek airports, domestic and international; arrivals not taxed.
notes: Effective date basis: By departure: fee on each passenger departing a Greek airport, collected by airlines before boarding; art. 16 par. 5: in force from 1 March 2001 (retroactive to before the 9 March 2001 publication). Government-set development levy: law-fixed rate, collected into Bank of Greece special accounts; at Athens 75% to the Spata Airport Development Fund (AIA development agreement) and 25% to the Civil Aviation Authority; at other state airports 80% to the airport's development fund and 20% to the CAA (2001 text). In scope as a state development fund, but CE Delft (2019) does not classify it as a ticket tax. Pre-2001 rates come from the 1992 law text; ministerial adjustments between 1992 and 2001 were not checked. Ν. 2668/1998 art. 27 and Ν. 2963/2001 art. 46 changed only use/collection paragraphs, not rates. Lead partly wrong: the original 1992 fee was distance-based, not domestic vs EU vs non-EU; the EU/non-EU split dates from 2001. FEK pages were read as page images (legacy-encoded PDFs from kodiko.gr).

tax_name: Ενιαίο Τέλος Εκσυγχρονισμού και Ανάπτυξης Αερολιμένων (Τ.Ε.Α.Α.) (Uniform Airport Modernisation and Development Fee (TEAA))
legal_basis: Ν. 4465/2017 (ΦΕΚ Α' 47/04.04.2017), άρθρο 52, replacing paras 7-13 of άρθρο 40 Ν. 2065/1992
rate_structure: After: uniform EUR 12 per departing passenger over 2 years, all destinations, from all Greek airports (until 1 Nov 2024). Before: EUR 12 EU/EEA (incl. domestic) and EUR 22 non-EU/EEA, passengers over 5. Change: non-EU departures -45% (22 to 12); EU/domestic unchanged; children aged 2-5 newly taxed.
transfer_exempt: yes: exempt are transit passengers on the same flight number, and air transfer passengers continuing with the same or another airline within 24 hours, shown by a single ticket or the stub of the previous leg; such passengers pay the fee once at the airport of departure (par. 8 β, γ). PSO routes, crew, state aircraft, emergency landings also exempt.
applies_to: All departing passengers (commercial and private aircraft and helicopters) from all Greek airports, domestic and international.
notes: Effective date basis: By departure: art. 52 § 2 applies from the handover of the 14 regional airports to the concessionaires (Fraport Greece took over operations on 11 April 2017); fee collected by airlines before boarding. Announcement_date is the HRADF/TAIPED (state privatisation fund) press release of 31 Aug 2016 announcing the uniform EUR 12 and the later EUR 3; the law was published 2017-04-04 after a parliamentary amendment of 29 Mar 2017 (news). Revenue: Athens 75% to the Spata Airport Development Fund and 25% to the CAA; the 14 Fraport airports 100% to the concessionaires; other state airports 50% airport fund and 50% CAA. CE Delft (2019) does not count TEAA as a ticket tax. The fee is set in law, but at concession airports the revenue goes to the private concessionaire (borderline with an airport charge).

tax_name: 国際観光旅客税 (International Tourist Tax)
legal_basis: 国際観光旅客税法 (平成30年法律第16号, promulgated 2018-04-18); 国際観光旅客税法施行令 (平成30年政令第161号)
rate_structure: JPY 1,000 per departure from Japan (air or ship), flat, any nationality. Before: none
transfer_exempt: partial: air transit passengers are non-taxable only if a single air ticket shows departure from Japan within 24 hours of scheduled arrival in Japan (Act art. 6(i), Order art. 4(1)); not exempt if the airport before entering Japan is the same as the airport after leaving Japan; ship transit passengers are not exempt
applies_to: departing international passengers by air and sea; domestic flights and arrivals not taxed; infants under 2, crew, deportees, official aircraft exempt
notes: Effective date basis: by both: departures on or after 2019-01-07; departures under contracts of carriage concluded before 2019-01-07 (with the departure date already fixed before that date) are not taxed, unless the contract provides for collecting the tax separately from the fare (附則第2条). National tax collected by carriers and paid to the tax office or customs. Announcement date used = promulgation date (MOF bill explanation dated February 2018). Later change outside window and announced after 2024: rate raised to JPY 3,000 by 令和8年法律第12号 (2026-03-31) for contracts concluded on or after 2026-07-01 (NTA Q&A Q19-Q20). No other national per-passenger aviation levy found for Japan 1996-2024; PSFC/旅客保安サービス料 are airport-set and excluded.

legal_basis: 관광진흥개발기금법 제2조제3항 as amended by 법률 제7132호 (2004-01-29); 시행령 대통령령 제18411호 (2004-06-05)

tax_name: 국제빈곤퇴치기여금 (from 2017: 국제질병퇴치기금 출국납부금) (International poverty eradication contribution (air ticket solidarity levy); from 2017 departure levy of the International Disease Eradication Fund)
legal_basis: 한국국제협력단법 제18조의2 inserted by 법률 제8316호 (2007-03-29); 시행령 제10조의2 (대통령령 제20276호, 2007-09-17); from 2017-01-01 국제질병퇴치기금법 제5조 (법률 제14404호, 2016-12-20)

tax_name: Passenger Movement Charge (Passenger Movement Charge (PMC))
legal_basis: Passenger Movement Charge Amendment Act 1998 (Act No. 66, 1998), assented 30 June 1998, commenced 1 January 1999; amends s 6 Passenger Movement Charge Act 1978; collected under Passenger Movement Charge Collection Act 1978
rate_structure: flat A$30 per departing passenger (before: A$27, in force since 1 July 1995); +11.1%
transfer_exempt: yes: transit passengers exempt (Passenger Movement Charge Collection Act 1978 s 5). 'Transit passenger' = a person who arrives in Australia from a place outside Australia for the purpose only of a journey to a place outside Australia and who, if arriving and departing by aircraft, departs without being immigration cleared (s 172 Migration Act 1958), or if cleared for reasons beyond their control departs as soon as reasonably practicable; in other cases departs less than 48 hours after arrival. Airside air-to-air transfers therefore exempt; passengers who clear immigration (stopovers, landside self-transfers) pay. Definition unchanged in substance over the window per amendment history (not checked line by line).
applies_to: departing persons leaving Australia for another country by air or sea (international departures only; no charge on arrivals or domestic flights). Exempt: under 12, crew, positioning crew, transit passengers, diplomats, certain defence personnel and others listed in Collection Act s 5.
notes: Effective date basis: departures on or after 1 January 1999 (application item 2; the application provision contains no exception for tickets sold earlier). below 20% threshold. Charge collected by airlines/shipping lines (at ticket sale) and remitted to the Commonwealth; flows to consolidated revenue. Lead said '$30 (1998?)': the increase took effect 1 January 1999. Second reading speech House of Representatives 28 May 1998; formal announcement date not confirmed. Baseline at 1996-01-01: A$27 (PMC replaced the Departure Tax in 1995; Senate committee 2008 table dates the A$27 PMC to 1 January 1995 while the legislation history shows the 1995 amendment commencing 1 July 1995).

tax_name: رسم المغادرة عن طريق مطار دبي الدولي (Dubai International Airport departure fee (Dubai Government levy; referred to as the passenger service charge by Dubai Airports in 2009 press coverage))
legal_basis: Dubai Law No. (3) of 2004 on imposing the departure fee through Dubai International Airport; issued 15/5/2004; Dubai Official Gazette No. 296 of 15/6/2004; Arts. 2 to 6
rate_structure: After: AED 30 per passenger departing the Emirate of Dubai via DXB to outside the UAE. Before: not established; a similar AED 30 charge may have existed before the law (not confirmed)
transfer_exempt: not stated in the law (exempt only children under 2 and aircrew on duty); Gulf News (2009) reports that transit and transfer passengers were not charged the Dubai passenger service charge
applies_to: passengers departing DXB for destinations outside the UAE
notes: Effective date basis: Art. 6: in force from 1 September 2004; airlines collect at ticket issuance, inside or outside the UAE (Art. 4). Sub-national (Emirate of Dubai). Set by Ruler's law, proceeds to the Dubai Department of Civil Aviation (a government department), so treated as a government levy rather than an airport-operator charge. Whether this law created a new charge or codified an existing passenger service charge is not confirmed.
source_quote: "يستوفى من كل مسافر عند مغادرته إمارة دبي عن طريق مطار دبي الدولي إلى خارج دولة الإمارات العربية المتحدة رسم مغادرة مقداره ثلاثون درهماً." [A departure fee of AED 30 is collected from every passenger leaving Dubai via DXB to outside the UAE] ; "ويعمل به اعتباراً من اليوم الأول من شهر سبتمبر سنة 2004" [effective from 1 September 2004]

tax_name: رسم المغادرة عن طريق مطار دبي الدولي (Dubai International Airport departure fee (passenger service charge))

rate_structure: After: AED 75 per departing passenger. Before: AED 30 (+150%)
transfer_exempt: yes (in practice): Gulf News reports the increase does not apply to transit or transfer passengers; the 2009 law text itself lists only infants and crew
applies_to: passengers departing DXB for destinations outside the UAE
notes: Effective date basis: law in force from its issue date 1/5/2009; per Dubai Airports (Gulf News): tickets issued on or after 1 April 2009 for travel on or after 1 May 2009. Sub-national (Emirate of Dubai). Government levy by law (see 2004 row). Announced by Dubai Airports on 26/3/2009.
source_quote: "رسم مغادرة مقداره خمسة وسبعون درهماً" [a departure fee of AED 75] ; "يعمل بهذا القانون اعتباراً من تاريخ صدوره" [in force from its date of issue] | "This will apply only to tickets issued on or after April 1 and travel on or after May 1." ; "The increase will not apply to transit or transfer passengers"

tax_name: رسم مغادرة عبر المنافذ الجوية للدولة (Federal departure fee on passengers leaving through UAE air ports)
legal_basis: Cabinet Resolution No. (10) of 2010 on the departure fee through the State's sea, air and land ports; issued 9/5/2010; Official Gazette No. 508 of 27/5/2010; Arts. 3 to 6, 9, 11
rate_structure: After: AED 30 per departing air passenger; revenue split 50% federal government, 50% local (emirate) government. Before: no federal air departure fee found
transfer_exempt: yes: exempt are 'passengers whose main destination is not the UAE (transit passengers)' and 'passengers on continuing flights (within 24 hours of arrival)' (Art. 4)
applies_to: passengers departing through UAE airports (international departures); exempt: children under 2, aircrew, transit and 24h continuing passengers; Art. 1 sets a separate AED 30 fee at land and sea ports (UAE and GCC nationals exempt there)
notes: Effective date basis: in force from Official Gazette publication 27/5/2010 (Art. 11); collected when the ticket is issued, wherever issued or bought (Art. 5); Art. 9 validates earlier Ministry of Finance agreements with local airport authorities from their contract dates, so collection of a federal share may predate 2010. Federal (national) levy, so the lead 'no federal tax' is wrong. Still in force (portal status 'in force', last update 9 May 2010; Cabinet Resolution 88 of 2022 expressly keeps it). Not confirmed whether it is an extra ticket charge or the federal share carved out of existing emirate departure fees: Dubai's own departure fee law (Law 13 of 2022) cites this resolution in its preamble, and no separate federal ticket tax line was found. Treat as possibly overlapping with the emirate departure fees below.

[A departure fee of AED 30 is collected from every passenger through the State's air ports] ; "المسافرون الذين لا تكون الدولة هي وجهتهم الرئيسية (ركاب الترانزيت)." [passengers whose main destination is not the State (transit passengers)] | "توزع الإيرادات الناتجة عن الرسم ... بنسبة 50% للحكومة الاتحادية و50% للحكومة المحلية" [revenue split 50% federal, 50% local government]

tax_name: رسم استخدام مرافق المطارات في إمارة أبوظبي (Abu Dhabi airports facility usage fee)
legal_basis: Abu Dhabi Executive Council Chairman Resolution No. 37 of 2016 on the airport facilities usage fee in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi; issued 7/4/2016; published in the Abu Dhabi Official Gazette (June 2016)
rate_structure: After: AED 35 per departing or transferring passenger. Before: none (existing AED 75 passenger service charge and AED 5 security fee at AUH are separate airport charges)
transfer_exempt: no: departing and transferring passengers ('continuing their journey on the same or another airline') are charged; exempt only transit passengers with the same arrival and departure flight number, children under 2, crew on duty
applies_to: passengers leaving the UAE via airports of the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, including connecting passengers
notes: Effective date basis: airlines collect at ticket issuance where departure from Abu Dhabi airports is on or after 30/6/2016. Sub-national (Emirate of Abu Dhabi). Set by emirate government resolution but proceeds go to Abu Dhabi Airports Company (state-owned airport operator), so borderline between a government levy and an airport charge. Primary gazette text not located; based on Al Bayan report quoting the gazette. The National (15/6/2016) also says introduced from June 30.

tax_name: رسم استخدام مرافق مطارات دبي (Dubai airports facility usage fee (Passenger Facility Charge))
legal_basis: Dubai Executive Council Resolution No. (8) of 2016 on collecting the Dubai airports facility usage fee from passengers; issued 7/3/2016; Arts. 1 to 4
rate_structure: After: AED 35 per departing passenger, including transit passengers. Before: none
transfer_exempt: no: transit and transfer passengers are charged; only transit passengers whose arrival and departure flight number is the same are exempt (plus infants under 2, crew on duty)
applies_to: all passengers departing Dubai airports (DXB, DWC) to outside the UAE, including connecting passengers
notes: Effective date basis: tickets issued from 1/3/2016 for departures after 30/6/2016 (Art. 2); Dubai Airports: travel on or after 1 July 2016, ticket sales on or after 1 March 2016. Sub-national (Emirate of Dubai). Set by the Dubai Executive Council; airlines remit to Dubai Airports Corporation but proceeds accrue to the general treasury of the Government of Dubai (Art. 3), so treated as a government levy. Lead 'transit passengers charged AED 35 from 2015-07-01' is wrong: it is 2016-07-01. Highly relevant for hub traffic because it hits transfers.
source_quote: "يُستوفى من كل مسافر بما في ذلك ركاب الترانزيت عند مغادرة أي منهم إمارة دبي عن طريق مطارات دبي إلى خارج دولة الإمارات العربية المتحدة رسم مقداره (35) خمسة وثلاثون درهماً" [AED 35 is collected from every passenger, including transit passengers, departing Dubai via Dubai airports to outside the UAE] ; "اعتباراً من 1/3/2016 متى كانت المغادرة من مطارات دبي بعد تاريخ 30/6/2016" [from 1/3/2016 where departure is after 30/6/2016] | "For those who travel from Dubai International on or after 1st July 2016, the fee will be added to the ticket price of all sales on or after 1st March 2016."

transfer_exempt: no: charged on transfer passengers connecting within 24 hours; exempt: same-aircraft through transit, involuntary reroutes, infants under 2 without seat, crew on duty

tax_name: Airport Development Fee (ADF) / رسوم تطوير المطارات (Airport Development Fee, Hamad International Airport)
legal_basis: QCAA circular (reported as Circular No. 2 of 2022; text not located); HIA Aeronautical Charges 2022/Jan-V1; Qatar AIP GEN 4.1 (AIRAC 24/3/2022)
rate_structure: After: QAR 60 per departing passenger, now including transfer passengers within 24 hours. Before: QAR 40 per originating departing passenger, transfers exempt (+50% and scope extended to transfers)
transfer_exempt: no (after): 'All departing and transfer passengers (up to and including 24 HR)'; before April 2022 transit/transfer passengers were exempt from the ADF. Exempt: same-plane transit, infants under 2 without seat, crew, involuntary reroutes
applies_to: departing and transfer passengers at Doha Hamad International Airport
notes: Effective date basis: tickets issued on or after 1 February 2022; charges effective 1 April 2022 (00:00 local time). Borderline, likely airport charges: changes announced in a Qatar Civil Aviation Authority (QCAA) circular reported 25/1/2022, but published as HIA aeronautical charges and paid to the airport operator MATAR. Included because the state regulator issued them and they extend to transfer passengers. Also a scope change: transfers became liable. Lead (QAR 35/40, changes 2017 or 2023) partly wrong: changes were Dec 2016 and April 2022.
